news.title: White House staff to need prior approval to meet with lobbyists, under Stephen Miller memo
news.summary: A new memo from White House chief of staff Stephen Miller says White House staffers need prior approval from the Office of White House Counsel if they want to meet with a lobbyist, a significant shift after the midterm shellacking of the GOP. “No President in history has fought more relentlessly, selflessly or courageously for…
